channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Preliminary Utilities Plant
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Preliminary Utilities Plant (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Preliminary Utilities Plant: The record described its shape as a real OpenStreetMap building footprint; OSM way 135103720 is actually a fenced industrial compound (tagged as industrial land use with a fence, not as a building), and the record now says so. It also said a CEQA filing gave the plant's address as 1500 Owens St, conflicting with OSM's 1480 4th St. The CEQA filing cited gives only Block 16B and no street address, and no record read gives 1500 Owens St, so the conflict was removed from the record's notes, address and open questions. The aerial photo credit names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per its user page) and drops the unsupported 'departing flight' wording.
